title: R$ 250 é caro?
concept: A price tag swings in ('R$ 250 por mês. É caro?'), splits into 30 day tags (R$ 250 ÷ 30 = R$ 8,33 por dia, menos que um lanche), then into a 720-dot matrix of farm hours (÷ 24) that collapses into the drop: R$ 0,35 por hora de farm; then 'Quanto vale 1 hora do seu tempo?' and your hour (dormir, trabalho, família) vs the bot's hour (hunt, captura, pesca), closing on a real customer reaction.

notes: Division shown as an operation: the result reads 'R$ 250 ÷ 30' at rest, counts down without a unit and only shows 'por dia' when it lands on R$ 8,33 (coordinator note). R$ 0,35 is the rounded 250/720 = 0,347 (the equation shows R$ 8,33 ÷ 24 = ? before the drop). The 'captura' chip uses a crosshair (no ball silhouette). The concept's paraphrase 'eu queria mt ter comprado isso antes' is NOT typed on screen: the real print reads 'eu quero mt ter comprado isso antes' + 'queria*', so the print itself is shown (verbatim) with 'print real de cliente'. Proof print: queria-ter-comprado-antes--quote.png (4 bubbles, customer's words only) under the headline 'E quem já usa?'.
